scope: 5 generated facial layers, assembled into daily and date families

jobs.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / expression-only edit.
Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the user's APPROVED FINAL LYDIA, an adult upper-district woman aged 27.
Create ONE facial-expression variation of this exact illustration. It will be a reusable facial layer for her daily and date outfits.
Character interpretation: Lydia's neutral partially lowered eyelids express worldly adult poise and calm confidence. Preserve that identity. Some emotions may open the lids further without changing her face design.
Requested expression (smile): Genuine bright happiness: raise the upper eyelids so the eyes open noticeably more than the neutral reference, revealing more of the existing amber irises. Keep the same horizontal eye corners and iris size. A lively, natural open smile, with a modest upper-tooth shape if appropriate. This is a poised adult woman enjoying herself, not a childlike exaggerated grin.
CRITICAL EYE RULES: preserve the original eye corner positions and horizontal eye width, existing amber iris/pupil size, iris colours and facial bone structure. For open-eye expressions, alter the lid aperture vertically to reveal more of the same eyes. Do NOT substitute oversized round modern-anime eyes, enlarge irises or make her look younger.
Change only eyebrows, eyelids, gaze nuance, mouth and the requested blush. LOCK the face shape, jaw and chin, exact head angle and position, hair silhouette, long mostly straight cool honey-brown hair and gently curved ends, rose-and-pearl ornament, pearl earrings, body, full bust volume and its lower level, shoulders, hands/arms, costume, lighting, colour handling, figure scale and canvas placement.
Keep the original author's warm restrained linework and controlled cel shading, with subtle natural adult emotion. Do not redesign, recolour, rejuvenate or change her outfit. No tears, sweat drops, emoticons or symbols.
Same complete head-to-natural-waist portrait and same canvas dimensions as the target, genuine transparent background. Normal high-resolution source illustration for later exact B/detail sampling; no pixel grid or dither. One portrait, one expression, no comparison sheet, text, UI, logo or watermark.
